payload.rationale: The latency SLA change (30s to 5s, p99 <= 5.0s) is correctly grounded in Addendum 0001. Four of the five retrieved chunks are directly relevant; the SOL-2026-CLOUD-01 amendment is off-target noise from a different solicitation.

Based on the provided sources, here is how Addendum 0001 modifies the specified requirements and the details of the architecture diagram for Solicitation 02 (SOL-2026-DATA-02):

*   **Streaming Ingestion Latency SLA (DATA-SLA-3.1):** Addendum 0001 amends Clause DATA-SLA-3.1 to reduce the maximum end-to-end Pub/Sub -> Dataflow -> BigQuery Silver streaming latency from 30 seconds down to 5 seconds (p99 <= 5.0 seconds) [1]. 

The provided sources do not contain information regarding the annual cost for 6,000 TB of Active Lakehouse Storage (CLIN-1004) [4], nor do they list or show the three Medallion storage layers in an architecture diagram [3].

evaluation.rationale: The latency SLA change (30s to 5s, p99 <= 5.0s) is correctly grounded in Addendum 0001. However, the answer wrongly claims the sources lack the CLIN-1004 annual cost and the Medallion layers, when the context explicitly gives the discounted $1,224,000 figure (vs. $1,440,000) and the Bronze/Silver/Gold layers, so two of the three parts are missed and misrepresented. Four of the five retrieved chunks are directly relevant; the SOL-2026-CLOUD-01 amendment is off-target noise from a different solicitation.
